incident-bot: PAGER: PAGER #1234 triggered for ClearWave (org:cw-789) — sustained 4xx/429s across edge, qps ~6x baseline. Paging on-call SRE.

maya.ops: Oncall page received — looking.

ben.sre: I'm on it, checking logs and qps graphs now.

ben.sre: Looks like routing queue backlog + spike in KV cache misses. Traffic pattern = many short requests, likely an automated test.

tara-cs: @ben.sre ClearWave CS thread says an internal test accidentally hit prod, they're seeing spike from a single service. It's affecting other tenants.

alex-eng: We should apply a temporary per-org RL to protect others. Recommend `max_concurrent=30` and `qps=300` for cw-789, TTL 15m.

ben.sre: Agree. Applying RL now. Command I'm running: `POST /admin/orgs/cw-789/rate_limit -d '{"qps":300,"concurrent":30,"ttl":"15m"}'`

devops-bot: deploy-bot: PATCH /admin applied — org cw-789 rate_limit updated (qps:300, concurrent:30, ttl:15m). Responses for cw-789 now returning 429 when over limit.

maya.ops: Monitoring: infra qps dropped back toward baseline for other orgs. CW shows ~98% of their requests getting 429 as expected. Latency for others stabilized :white_check_mark:.

tara-cs: I informed ClearWave CS that we're throttling for 15m while they remediate. They asked if we can do a short priority bump so their recovery scripts can finish.

ben.sre: We can offer a controlled bump if they coordinate. Option: increase qps -> 600 for 10m and require them to throttle clients. Need explicit ack from customer.

alex-eng: Also toggling off heavy paths for them — disabling feature `async_batch` for cw-789 to reduce backend pressure. Command: `PATCH /admin/orgs/cw-789/features -d '{"async_batch":false}'`

devops-bot: feature toggle applied for cw-789: async_batch=false.

maya.ops: Handing monitoring to night-oncall @oscar-sre. ben.sre please stay reachable for escalation.

oscar-sre: Taking over monitoring. Watching dashboards, org-rate-spike alerts, and error budgets. DM if anything spikes.

tara-cs: Update from customer: they confirmed misconfigured test, will stop and re-run only against staging. CS to schedule postmortem with them.

ben.sre: Logging RCA note: root cause = customer misconfigured integration flooding prod; mitigations = per-org RL applied (300qps -> temporary bump 600qps if requested), disabled async_batch feature, applied TTL-based rate_limit overrides. Will open formal incident ticket and add timeline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: INC-2026-0789 marked mitigated for cross-tenant impact. Please add notes and timeline to #postmortems.
_notes: thread contains commands and bot messages; short informal Slack style; follow-up required in postmortems
